text.title: 不见了的信封
text.situation:
午饭后，玛雅找不到装着空白募款表格的信封。她记得自己清理桌面时移动过它。这是一个普通失误，却让她尴尬。乔有个明智建议：先查抽屉，再召集整个团队。信封就在一叠传单下面。玛雅为放错地方承担责任，把它的位置记在桌面记录旁。

玛雅：我很敬佩你这样认真保管记录。
乔：这些记录属于在这里帮忙的每个人。
玛雅：我怕受到责怪。
乔：比起完美表现，我们更需要诚实。人们信任我们，交给我们钱，诚信很重要。
玛雅：我会告诉下一位信封在哪里。
乔：那是尊重下一位负责人的交接方式。

墙上一张报纸剪贴称这家慈善机构是受人尊重的组织。乔说，好声誉需要持续用行动维护。玛雅再次看着那个小盒子，明白了为什么连空白表格也重要。

paragraphs.en: After lunch, Maya could not find the envelope that held the empty collection forms. She remembered moving it while clearing the desk. It was an ordinary mistake, but she felt embarrassed. Jo had a sensible suggestion: check the drawer before calling the whole team. The envelope was there, under a stack of leaflets. Maya took responsibility for putting it in the wrong place and wrote its location beside the desk record.

paragraphs.en:
Maya: I respect how carefully you keep these records.
Jo: They belong to everyone who helps here.
Maya: I was afraid I would be blamed.
Jo: We need honesty more than a perfect performance. Integrity matters when people trust us with their money.
Maya: I will tell the next person where the envelope is.
Jo: That is a respectful way to hand over the desk.

paragraphs.en: A newspaper cutting on the wall called the charity a respectable organisation. Jo said a good reputation was something it had to keep earning. Maya looked again at the small box and understood why even the empty forms mattered.

acceptableAnswers: 玛雅敬佩乔的认真。她的交接表示尊重，而报纸说慈善机构值得尊重。
